Interface ResourcePredicate

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ResourcePredicate
A condition on resource variants (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.3). Tags are evaluated against the snapshot passed in, so predicates stay valid across tag reloads. Matching never implies conversion.
